articles.title: Verstappen building major momentum as 'no-one very happy' at McLaren
articles.description: Max Verstappen's revival might not be a serious issue for Kimi Antonelli but it is for McLaren, who had a bad Saturday in Singapore, writes Andrew Benson.

articles.title: F1: Chequered Flag
articles.description: Could Max Verstappen continue his fine form and take victory in the Singapore sprint?

articles.title: Verstappen beats Ferraris to Singapore pole
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen beats the Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton to pole position in qualifying at the Singapore Grand Prix.

articles.title: Verstappen wins sprint after Russell crashes out
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen wins an incident-packed sprint race at the Singapore Grand Prix after George Russell crashes out of the lead.

articles.title: Verstappen on sprint pole after another settings issue
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen beats Mercedes driver George Russell to sprint pole at the Singapore Grand Prix.
